caption: The drawing features three objects located close to the center of an otherwise empty beige background. At the top of this central area is a small, colored illustration of a ring; the ring appears gold with a shiny, oval-shaped, gray or blue gemstone set in the middle. Below the colored ring are two simple line drawings in gray pencil or ink. The line drawing on the left shows a top-down view of the ring's band and bezel, while the drawing to the right is a side view, displaying the profile of the ring, including its band and setting. The artist's signature, "M. Fenga," is written at the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Mourning Ring
